description: This file defines composable UI components for rendering chat messages in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes components for message bubbles, typing indicators, tool callouts, and code blocks, with styling determined by the message role.

classes.name: ChatBubbleStyle
classes.description: Data class to define style properties for chat message bubbles, including alignment, container color, border color, and role label color.

methods.name: ChatMessageBubble
methods.description: Renders a chat message bubble with content based on message role and content parts.

methods.name: ChatBubbleContainer
methods.description: Provides a styled container for chat bubbles with role label and content layout.

methods.name: ChatMessageBody
methods.description: Displays the content parts of a chat message, including text and base64 images.

methods.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
methods.description: Displays a typing indicator bubble for the assistant role.

methods.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
methods.description: Shows a bubble indicating pending tool calls, with details and a count of additional hidden tools.

methods.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
methods.description: Displays a streaming message bubble indicating a live assistant message.

methods.name: bubbleStyle
methods.description: Determines the style of chat bubbles based on the role (user, system, or default).

methods.name: roleLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for different roles.

methods.name: ChatBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image from a base64 string or an unsupported message if loading fails.

methods.name: DotPulse
methods.description: Creates a pulsing dot animation for typing indicators.

methods.name: PulseDot
methods.description: Represents a single pulsing dot used in the typing indicator.

methods.name: ChatCodeBlock
methods.description: Displays a code block with optional language label, styled with monospace font.
